mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relay_channels (channel_id, name, channel_type, visibility, description, archived, created_at_ms) VALUES (#{row.channelId}, #{row.name}, #{row.channelType}, #{row.visibility}, #{row.description}, #{row.archived}, #{row.createdAtMs})
mapper.update: UPDATE relay_channels SET name = #{row.name}, channel_type = #{row.channelType}, visibility = #{row.visibility}, description = #{row.description}, archived = #{row.archived} WHERE channel_id = #{row.channelId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM relay_channels c INNER JOIN relay_channel_members m ON m.channel_id = c.channel_id WHERE m.agent_id = #{agentId} AND c.archived = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO relay_channel_members (channel_id, agent_id, role, name, added_at_ms) VALUES (#{row.channelId}, #{row.agentId}, #{row.role}, #{row.name}, #{row.addedAtMs})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM relay_channel_members WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM relay_channel_members WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO relay_agents (agent_id, sandbox_id, capabilities, rules, registered_at_ms, status, active_tasks) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{sandboxId}, #{capabilities}, #{rules}, #{registeredAtMs}, 'idle', 0)
mapper.select: SELECT agent_id AS agentId, status, active_tasks AS activeTasks, registered_at_ms AS registeredAtMs, last_heartbeat_ms AS lastHeartbeatMs FROM relay_agents
